invariants: Existing Context Graph and raw-source records remain authoritative and are never mutated by shadow projection.
Every shadow document is bound to a stable map identity, source digest, SiYuan block identity, and authoritative Markdown digest.
Projection and rollback create a SiYuan repository snapshot before mutation.

stages.reason: The checked-in renderer, native, embedded-manifest, and verifier gates are enabled after pinned-runtime acceptance while existing Context records remain authoritative.
The pinned project-scoped loopback runtime booted, authenticated, served typed reads, and shut down inside the owned fixture.
The additive projector inventories exact Context snapshots, writes stable managed documents, rereads them, persists resumable mappings, and proves source bytes unchanged in focused tests.
Feature-gated Context federation retains existing Context authority and adds SiYuan candidates under the unified result contract in focused tests.
Approve-only, typed create/update/delete, snapshot-first application, authoritative reread, compensation, and rollback are covered without enabling production writes.
External Context note-content bytes and full official-UI round-trip fidelity have not yet passed the real-runtime migration acceptance matrix.
